name: PR Review Digest
tagline: Summarizes open PRs, review state, blockers, and the next reviews to do.
description: Summarizes open pull requests, review status, blockers, and what needs attention. It connects to GitHub pull request APIs or compatible code-review export endpoints through operator-configured HTTPS source endpoints. Credentials are referenced by local environment variable name, for example GITHUB_TOKEN, so secret values stay in BFrost .env instead of worker settings or store packages.
author: @ccascio

versions.changelog: Initial source-backed worker package with clearer token setup guidance and validation for environment variable names.
